note: Adapted from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera); the original is in English, and the original description is that of Maiti & Chakraborty 1981 (placed in Glyptotermes). There are three sections: dealated alate, soldier and pseudoworker. OCR problems: the head length of the soldier is given in the original as '1.15-1.123' and the head width as 'l.lS-1.20'; the last digit of the former is doubtful and is reproduced as such and flagged; the antennal count of the alate, '5+ segmented', seems to be missing a leading digit and is also reproduced as such.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dealated adult: head capsule, pronotum, wing scales and abdominal tergites dark brown; antennae, labrum, legs and sternites paler. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length without wings 4.25 mm. Head capsule almost circular, head length to the base of the mandibles 0.88 mm, slightly greater than the head width including the eyes, 0.84 mm; posterior margin rounded. Compound eyes black, suboval, maximum diameter 0.25 mm, 0.14 mm from the lower margin of the head capsule. Ocelli oval, translucent, small, maximum diameter 0.07 mm, very close to the eye patch. Antennae with more than 5 segments (the original reads 5+ segmented); segment 2 shortest. Anteclypeus white, subtrapezoidal, far wider than long. Postclypeus paler than the frons, band-like; anterior margin nearly straight. Labrum broadly ligulate, hairy, anterior margin rounded, far wider than long (width 0.38 mm, length 0.26 mm). Pronotum subrectangular, far wider than long (width 0.80 mm, length 0.57 mm), about equal to the head width without the eyes; anterior margin deeply concave, without a median notch; posterior margin nearly straight; anterolateral angles narrower than the posterolateral ones; the margins and the body with a few erect hairs. Legs short, hairy; tibial spurs 3:3:3; tarsus 4-segmented; arolia present. Fore wing scale far longer than the hind wing scale and covering it. Abdomen long-oval, hairy; cerci 2-segmented, stylet 1-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown, almost black anteriorly; mandibles dark brown; labrum dark brown; antennae pale brown; anteclypeus white, postclypeus black; pronotum brown; legs and abdomen yellowish brown, the fore legs slightly darker. Head and thorax moderately hairy, abdomen more densely hairy; the posterior margin of each tergite with a row of hairs. Body length 5.4—6.0 mm. Head capsule subsquare, slightly longer than wide; head length to the base of the mandibles 1.15—1.123 mm (as in the original, where the last digit is probably an OCR error), head width 1.15—1.20 mm; sides almost parallel, abruptly narrowed at the antennal ridges; anterior part of the head bilobed, with a deep V-shaped depression between the lobes; surface of the lobes very rough; anterior part of the frons sharply truncate; a prominent tubercle above each antennal socket, and a horn-like ventral projection on each cheek below the antennal socket; dorsal surface of the head weakly concave in the middle; Y-shaped suture absent. Compound eyes suboval, white, dot-like, situated slightly below the antennal sockets; distance between eye and antenna 0.15—0.17 mm. Ocelli absent. Antennae 11—12-segmented, rather densely hairy; segments 3 and 4 almost equal, shortest. Anteclypeus white, narrow, far wider than long, narrowing forwards into a slightly convex margin. Postclypeus strongly sclerotized, wider than long, anterior margin nearly straight; posterior boundary with the frons indistinct; sides slightly raised, forming a shallow median depression. Labrum slightly longer than wide, extending beyond half of the mandibles; length 0.25—0.27 mm, width 0.23—0.26 mm; anterior margin nearly circular, sides weakly convex; sparsely hairy. Mandibles slightly more than half the head length (to the base of the mandibles), short, with a weak basal swelling on the outer margin; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, right mandible with 2 stout marginal teeth. Postmentum longer than wide, widest at the anterior third; length 0.65—0.75 mm, width 0.38—0.45 mm, minimum width 0.25—0.28 mm; sides narrowing anteriorly and posteriorly; anterior margin concave; posterior margin weakly convex. Pronotum far wider than long (width 1.13—1.22 mm, length 0.67—0.75 mm), almost as wide as the head; anterior margin broad and deeply concave; posterior margin deeply notched; the margins and the body with a few hairs. Legs short, stout, sparsely hairy; the fore legs stouter than the others; tibial spurs 3:3:3, one spur on the outer side of the fore tibia far stouter than the other two; tarsus 4-segmented. Abdomen long, sparsely hairy; cerci 2-segmented; stylet 1-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule and antennae white; the rest of the body brownish white. Head capsule almost circular, head length to the base of the mandibles 0.92—1.00 mm, width 1.00—1.11 mm. Compound eyes suboval, large, white. Ocelli absent. Antennae 12-segmented, sparsely hairy; segment 4 shortest. Labrum broadly ligulate, width 0.29—0.37 mm, length 0.15—0.24 mm; anterior margin nearly straight; the margins and the body with a few hairs. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum wider than long (width 0.90—1.03 mm, length 0.60—0.69 mm), slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin broadly concave; posterior margin weakly notched. Legs short, hairy; tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsus 4-segmented. Abdomen long, hairy; cerci 2-segmented; stylet 1-segmented.
